## Summary
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noSvelteLegacyConst`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`svelte`](/linter/domains#svelte)
## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noSvelteLegacyConst": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow legacy Svelte `{@const}` tags.

Declaration tags provide the current syntax for deriving values in Svelte markup (available since Svelte 5.56).

## Examples

### Invalid

```svelte
{#each boxes as box}
    {@const area = box.width * box.height}
    <p>{area}</p>
{/each}
```

<pre class="language-text"><code class="language-text"></code></pre>

### Valid

```svelte
{#each boxes as box}
    {const area = $derived(box.width * box.height)}
    <p>{area}</p>
{/each}
```

### References

- [Svelte declaration tags](https://svelte.dev/docs/svelte/declaration-tags)
